standing_rules: At a new chat start read RULES.md from main and CHAT_SESSION_STATE.json from chat-session-state, then verify live GitHub state.
GitHub is the development control plane/source of truth; VAX/OpenVMS is authoritative for DEC C/VAX, RMS, DCL, runtime, and generated/uncommitted acceptance.
Omit literal OVMS-AGENT> from lines intended for OVMS Agent; all agent commands must be one physical input line.
Use GITAUTH for prompt-free raw Git network operations; never configure credential.helper store/global/askpass.
Keep core.filemode=false on this VAX checkout until #86 is fully accepted.
Verify exact HEAD after VAX Git ref-changing operations; native success text alone is not acceptance evidence.
DEC C/VAX C89: declarations at block starts; external/link-visible identifiers <=31 chars; no implicit declarations.
Never call an untested GitHub head VAX-green.
Canonical root acceptance requires All regression tests passed and final status %X00000001.
Until #83 is accepted, do not rely on the currently installed Agent image for arbitrary AGENT/TOOL/RUN source-edit payloads.
Never record credential values in durable state.
